//: The project predates this repo being a Next.js app -- it was created when
Kadi was four static HTML files, so its dashboard settings serve the
output directory as static assets and never run a build. After the
migration that left / with nothing to serve (404) while /invite.html and
/scanner.html kept working, because those are real files under public/.
Pinning the framework here rather than fixing it only in the dashboard
keeps the deployment config in the repo, so a future project re-create or
a preview branch cannot silently go back to serving static files.
//outputDirectory: The build was already running after framework was pinned -- the generated
public/engine/ files are live and they are gitignored, so they can only
have come from prebuild. What was still broken is that /_next/static 404s,
meaning .next was being discarded and public/ served as a flat static
directory. That is an explicit Output Directory override on the project.
